stories.title: New Treasury rules could close the court challenge route for projects like Connah’s Quay low carbon power station
stories.summary: The UK Government has proposed giving Parliament a direct vote on major energy projects and restricting the grounds on which those decisions can be challenged in court. stories.title: Nearly three quarters of 11 to 17 year olds saw harmful content online, Ofcom finds
stories.summary: Nearly three-quarters of 11 to 17 year olds have seen harmful content online in the past month, according to research published by Ofcom on Thursday. stories.title: Welsh rivers charity says new Clean Water Bill ‘not enough’ for Wales
stories.summary: The Welsh charity that represents the rivers trust covering the Dee has said the UK Government’s new Clean Water Bill is not enough for Wales. stories.summary: Nursing staff in Wales say staffing levels are not matching the complexity of care patients now need, with too many shifts operating without enough registered nurses to deliver safe and effective care, the Royal College of Nursing says. stories.title: Young people reaching out to Childline for online child sexual abuse rises by 36%
